failures.cause: Using info.field_name in validate_group_id_or_to_numbers actually runs the mutual-exclusion check on explicit to_numbers=None (kwargs.get('field_name') was always None under Pydantic v2 @validator, so the check was dead code), and info.data does not yet contain group_id when to_numbers is validated first.
failures.fix: Replace this cross-field field_validator with a @model_validator(mode='after') that requires group_id or to_numbers, or enforce the rule only on group_id after to_numbers is present in info.data, so group_id-only calls from send_group_message are not rejected.
